proposal.goal: Advance Chu-kei Insight Plan Detection from 375/3,709 (10.11%) to at least 928 resolved companies (>=25%). Prioritize company-count breadth. Align public/site data and release metadata with the canonical universe/registry, then expand in bounded resumable batches using reviewed evidence and official/first-party IR sources. Never weaken review gates, infer missing evidence into resolved states, or add unrelated features. Criteria: [1] Canonical registry/public summary reach >=25% coverage (>=928/3,709; recalculate ceil(universe*0.25) if the authoritative universe changes). [2] Each newly resolved company has official/first-party evidence with source identity, dates/period semantics and provenance; ambiguous, stale or unreviewed evidence stays unresolved. [3] Complete review evidence before derived registry/site rebuilds; preserve formal-plan/full-text/no-inference safeguards and regression tests. [4] Frontend manifest, Plan Detection summary and release metadata match canonical data; repository-side sync/smoke checks have no deterministic blocker, and external hosting actions are recorded explicitly. [5] Relevant tests, source/audit checks, quality gates and resumable-pipeline checks are green, and ADE remains resumable beyond 25%. Continue from current repository state until all criteria are demonstrably satisfied; do not stop at intermediate milestones while safe executable work remains. Preserve CI, provenance, quota limits, and existing human-only review/safety boundaries. Never invent unsupported facts or bypass required review. Only after all criteria and final repository/runtime checks are green, write docs/ADE_COVERAGE_25_COMPLETION.json with schema_version=1,status=COMPLETE plus concise evidence. Otherwise choose the highest-value bounded next work. Declare exact new_paths for new files.
